fact: The Budget 2023 Address of 4 November 2022 projects R 27.13 million in the 2023 budget for the continuation of the Health Information System project, within R 118.8 million of health sector investment, and says the health information system is expected to come into operation towards the end of 2022.
title: Budget 2023
publisher: Government of Seychelles, Minister for Finance, National Planning and Trade
